text.p: The following are some leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

Major financial groups as well as foreign investors are becoming more interested in health care services. Besides health insurance, some financial groups are also starting to buy and manage hospital units.

Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco sees public employee wage rises under three percent in 1998. Government to offer 2.6 percent initially when negotiations start at end September, according to Finance Ministry soources.
Due to their experience in Expo Seville '92, Spanish contractors are winning many contracts for Expo '98 in Lisbon.

The Portuguese Hotels Association wants Portuguese groups or companies to win the privatisations of Portuguese airline company TAP Air-Portugal and aiport authority ANA in order to safeguard the interest of the local tourism industry.

The Portuguese government is negotiating with Morocco to finance the last stretch of a motorway between Rabat and Tangiers. In return, the work would be entrusted to Portuguese companies, the paper quoted Moroccon official sources as saying.
